title: CaPU v0.18 — Precise Trap / Privilege Recovery
scope: bounded reduced-width one-trap privilege recovery model content-bound to the exact v0.17 architectural/causal/replay checkpoint authority, with wrong-privilege, interrupt-mask, trap-entry/return and pre-trap visible-effect containment semantics

workflow.name: CaPU vCML Precise Trap Privilege Recovery v0.18

deterministic_paths: checkpoint preparation with altered privilege bytes is rejected
exact full v0.18 payload completes prepare, persistence and authority commit
valid anchor plus altered explicit restore privilege is rejected
exact restore re-establishes PC 0x40, privilege 1, idle trap context and interrupt mask
normal continuation presented under a different privilege is rejected without advancing PC
exception and interrupt presented together select the exception
pending pre-trap abstract effect cannot become visible during accepted trap entry and is discarded
trap return restores recorded PC 0x40 and privilege 1
correct-privilege normal continuation advances PC to 0x41

workflows: CaPU vCML Precise Trap Privilege Recovery v0.18

upstream_assumption: the embedded v0.17 checkpoint payload and off-path SHA-256 commitment verification remain the authoritative base; the v0.18 RTL model does not implement SHA-256 internally
claim_boundary: bounded reduced-width one-trap privilege-recovery result; no full ISA/CSR/delegation, nested traps, MMU/TLB/page-fault semantics, NMI/debug, interrupt-controller or synchronization correctness, production speculation, cache/coherence/multicore, RTL SHA-256/verifier trustworthiness, durable-media or unbounded correctness is claimed
